final_message:
All 12 tests pass.

- `ringbuf/buffer.py` — real ring buffer: preallocated slots with head/size tracking, overwrite-vs-`BufferFull` on push, FIFO `pop`, `full`/`empty`, oldest-to-newest iteration and int indexing (slices raise `TypeError`), `latest`, `clear`/`drain`, and the specified `repr`.
- `ringbuf/stats.py` — `rolling_mean(buf, n)` via `buf.latest(n)`, raising `ValueError` for `n < 1` or an empty buffer.
